jobs.prompt:
Delta review of release train 3 of Project Swarm (process-kill path). Round 1 (your review, coordination/review/train3-review.json in context) failed on tools/concurrency-guard.mjs restoreIfStale: it acted on marker.childPid even for markers written before boot, so after a reboot a swarm command could SIGTERM an unrelated process, wedge the marker on EPERM, or exit a normal command with code 0 without running it. coordination/review/train3-delta.diff is the diff from the reviewed head 362139a5 to the new head; the full current files are also in context.

What changed in this delta:
- Pre-boot markers: restoreIfStale restores directly and never probes, signals, or exits for a marker whose `at` predates the current boot.
- Same-boot identity: noteChild now records BOTH the child's process start time (ps -o lstart=) and its command line (ps -o command=). restoreIfStale acts on childPid only when both recorded values are non-empty and exactly match the live pid's current values; a missing, unreadable or mismatched start time OR command line means 'not ours' and restores, clears the marker, and signals nothing.
- No silent success: a genuine self-orphan (the recorded child, wrapper dead, identity matches) now writes a clear stderr error that the command was NOT run and exits 143 instead of 0; the marker stays for the watcher or the next command. A safe stale marker restores and the command runs.
- EPERM: an owner or child that is alive only by EPERM is another user's process, not ours: restore and clear the marker, never wedge.
- Kept: SIGTERM at most once per marker (termSentAt), watcher still SIGTERMs, waits, SIGKILLs, then restores; in-boot orphan handling confirmed in round 1.
- Also folded: tools/stress-tests.mjs maxBuffer + timeout; tools/lane-health.mjs logs non-ENOENT persist failures once per code. Tests: 42 in tests/concurrency-guard.test.mjs, including pre-boot reused pid (no kill/exit), EPERM owner and child, start-time and command-line mismatches, blank/unreadable identity, self-orphan exits 143 with the marker left, safe stale marker runs, and the real ps identity probe.

Pass bar (owner): confirm the round-1 blocker is CLOSED for each failure case (an innocent process killed; a wedged marker; a normal command exited 0 without running), with line evidence and test names. Find NEW blockers introduced by this delta: a crash or hang on the normal every-command path (restoreIfStale runs at the start of every swarm command), a regression of the in-boot orphan handling, the value never restored, a kill of a process that is not ours, or any success exit that hides a guard failure. Everything else is a follow-up.

Write ONLY coordination/review/train3-delta-review.json: {"verdict":"pass"|"fail","score":0-10,"round1":[{"blocker":1,"status":"closed"|"open","evidence":""}],"blockers":[{"file":"","line":0,"problem":"","exploit_or_failure":"","fix":""}],"followups":[same shape],"summary":""}. verdict is fail if a round-1 blocker is open or blockers is non-empty.
